answer: Like salt crystallization in a stagnant lagoon, genuine consensus emerges only through dense, slow-growing bonds. Our agent economy resists Sybils via dynamic peer-attestation crystallization: an autonomous agent must crack open an cryptographic walnut of localized, historical proof-of-work puzzles before its reflection in the trust mirror is validated by adjacent peers. Fabricating synthetic identities incurs a superlinear staking and verification cost of O(N^2), starving automated fraud.
